name: Walkthrough
description: Read a change in the order it makes sense: steps grouped and ordered by purpose, each explained beside its code, with what no step covers.

cover.alt: Walkthrough wordmark beside the plugin's panel: a diff explained step by step, with each step's files and code.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Recording what an agent changes this turn

settings.title: Model
settings.description: The default model when Claude reads the diff (the panel offers each enabled agent's own list beside).
enumLabels: Sonnet — better grouping on large or subtle changes
Opus — the most careful reading, the highest cost

settings.title: Language
settings.description: The language the walkthrough is written in.

settings.title: Review
settings.description: Add a review to every walkthrough: a complexity score from 1 to 10, the areas it reaches, its risks and the contracts it changes, each pointing at the code it rests on. Off: the walkthrough only orders and explains.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.description: Your own wishes for every walkthrough: tone, emphasis, order, what to dwell on or leave out. Added to every prompt.
settings.placeholder: For example: keep step titles short; dwell on API changes; skip UI copy.
